title: Streak and score title
summary: The ticket and the share text gain a playful title by score band ("Zkušený tipař", "Čte myšlenky strojům") in red under the score, plus the current streak ("Série 8 dní") when it is two days or more. The shared link becomes /hra/<date>.
tradeoffs: Adds a gamified label that some players may find cheesy; titles are generic, not question-specific.
